notes: Site: IKEA UK (ikea.com/gb/en). Homepage mega-menu explicitly labels a nav link 'Clearance' pointing to https://www.ikea.com/gb/en/cat/last-chance/ (seen repeated as a 'hot' link across many category sub-menus, always the same base URL with only a subcategory filter query param appended - facet filters of one listing, not separate PLPs, so only the canonical unfiltered URL is emitted). Opened the page with Playwright (tier 2, after tier-1 HTTP fetch showed only client-rendered nav JSON, no product grid). On-page H1 is 'Last chance' with copy: "It's your last chance to buy these beloved IKEA products. Find furniture and home accessories that are leaving our range to make room for new products. This curated selection is available only while stock lasts." - this is a permanent end-of-line/outlet concept (site's own taxonomy: nav calls it 'Clearance', page itself says 'leaving our range' / 'while stock lasts'), not a temporary promotional sale, so it clears the Clearance-vs-Sale test in Sec.3. Individual product tiles within this single listing carry two sub-badges - 'Last chance' (discontinued line, no discount) and 'Clearance' (temporarily reduced 'Special price', e.g. '25% off, save GBP1 - Price valid from 15 Jun and while supply lasts') - both are merchandised together under the one /cat/last-chance/ URL with no separate URL per badge type (the 'Special price' facet, '85 products', is only an in-page filter, not a distinct PLP), so kept as a single row rather than invented sub-categories. Header shows '496 items' (shown twice) and the results-list footer independently confirms 'Showing 24 of 496 results' - cross-checked, qty verified reliable. Separately checked https://www.ikea.com/gb/en/offers/ (nav: 'Offers & deals') and https://www.ikea.com/gb/en/offers/limited-time-offers/ ('Reduced to clear') - these are temporary/seasonal promotional campaign pages (IKEA Family member offers, time-limited banners), not permanent outlet merchandising per the site's own taxonomy, so excluded per the Clearance-vs-Sale rule. No other clearance/outlet-labelled entry point found in nav, footer, or search.

rows.evidence: Rendered page text: '496 items' (page header, shown twice) and 'Showing 24 of 496 results' (results-list footer) - both consistent, captured via Playwright render of https://www.ikea.com/gb/en/cat/last-chance/. Main site nav labels this exact URL 'Clearance'; on-page H1 is 'Last chance' with copy describing products 'leaving our range' - permanent end-of-line/outlet merchandising, not a temporary sale.
